title: Buddy Petit's funeral and the two bands
summary: Howard recalls playing Petit's funeral with Eureka and his own brass band around 1931.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I think in 31 he was here. And he was Paul Bell and I played Buddy Petit's film.
How many bands did they use?
They had two. They had the Eureka band and I had my brass band.
How big was your band then in those days? Ten. About ten. About ten. About ten. About the same, did you use saxes then or clarinet and alitoes or what did you use?

Well, we were at clarinet and I just remember all the fellas, it's been so long time before. Twenty years. But I know George was there. Jim was there. Little Jim at that time, he was playing the tuba. Playing the tuba. Yeah.
I heard him even a couple years ago. He was still there.
Well I mean he was on the street with me. And at that time when I had met Buddy maybe about five or six years before he died. And when he really was playing all that trumpet and stuff like that.
